description: A transnational AI regulatory tribunal, formed from mid-sized EU and Nordic states, issues a second ruling demanding transparency from a U.S. hyperscaler, citing precedent from national courts in Belgium and Finland. Its technical credibility grows, and more member states signal informal alignment, testing the limits of supranational authority without treaty basis.

The wave of hyper-personalized disinformation intensifies, now mimicking regional officials to spread false emergency orders about energy rationing and AI system shutdowns. The content is coordinated across multiple platforms and languages, eroding trust in both national and EU-level institutions, with growing suspicion that a state actor is exploiting EU fragmentation.
